name: Császártöltés (Hungary)
description: Greyish light blue field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Császártöltés (a yellow and white shield with a dove and two figures holding a bunch of grapes) between the name Császártöltés above and 1744 Tschasartet below in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
